exclusions: Every lead and candidate in prior immutable requests through 2026-08-25 was excluded, together with all 26 canonical identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material, the protected Deep Under → Wurk opening handoff, Iruka summit, protected ending, and untriggered PARKED entries.
Current A.Morgan material was excluded because official descriptions foreground high pressure, pummeling rhythm, vocals, brutal low-end weight, destabilization, or euphoria.
KUSS Bleep Cult was excluded because its official description foregrounds heavy metallic undertones, massive atmosphere, and uncompromising intensity rather than low-attention mutation.
Message 431 material was excluded where exact descriptions foreground dense textures, distortion, heavy low-end, physical pressure, or the release's most forceful point.
Vakat Legato and POL// Stellar supplied relevant release-level control, tension, and gradual-evolution language but insufficient exact-track behavioural distinction for an honest resolver lead.
IGLO Blink Twice and Forlornly were excluded because dense weight or a calm drifting closure did not support a clearer non-protected function than Alive.
House, melodic, vocal-led, peak-time, impact-led, industrial, broken-tempo, protected-ending-only, and stylistically remote results were excluded from the current canonical grammar.
No lead was admitted for novelty, release recency, popularity, duration, BPM, key, artist reputation, label reputation, or quota completion.
explorationReceipt.evidenceLimit: Official attributed exact-track behaviour plus exact identity, duration, release date, and external tempo metadata only; no Spotify audio analysis, no raw-audio measurement, and no candidate-specific listener report.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.
